# Superdock

> Superdock is a macOS Dock replacement that gives every Google Chrome profile its own Dock icon, with that profile's avatar, window list and hover previews. It also adds an Alt-Tab style window switcher, a dock on every display, and clickable dock edges for Mission Control and Show Desktop, while matching Apple's Dock pixel for pixel.

Key facts:

- Platform: macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later, Apple silicon and Intel. Signed with an Apple Developer ID and notarized.
- Price: $7.99 one-time (launch price, list $13.99). One licence covers up to five Macs. All updates included. No subscription.
- Price: the dock is free to download and stays free. Chrome profile icons are free for 14 days, then $7.99 once (no account, no card for the trial). Licences are not on sale yet: the payment provider is completing business verification, and superdock.app/buy.html takes email addresses to notify when it opens.
- Folder stacks: clicking a folder in the dock opens its contents above it as a grid or list (folders first, then files); Downloads is pinned on first launch if the Dock has no folders.
- How it works: Chrome keeps running as one process; Superdock attributes windows to profiles from window titles and Chrome's profile list. No second Chrome instance, so no extra memory and no re-login.
- Permissions: Accessibility (required). Screen Recording (optional, live thumbnails).
- Distribution: direct download and in-app updates over a signed feed; not on the Mac App Store (it uses private macOS Dock interfaces).
- Contact: hello@superdock.app
